newsitem.title: UK: REED UP ON TALK OF BID, BOOKS DISPOSAL.
newsitem.headline: REED UP ON TALK OF BID, BOOKS DISPOSAL.

text.p: Shares in Reed International Plc rose to their highest level in four months on Thursday amid persistent market speculation of a bid from Reuters Holdings Plc , dealers said.
Separately a report in the Independent newspaper said Reed was moving ahead with the sale of its consumer books division to a management buyout team.
Reed shares were up 46-1/2p at 11.94 stg by 1015 GMT, after rising as high as 11.97 stg -- their highest since last October -- in volume of 1.7 million shares.
Reuters shares were up 16p at 683-1/2 in volume of 2.0 million.
Both companies declined comment on the latest bout of market rumour. "This is all just pure speculation," said a spokesman for Reed.
